title: CoNP membership of the inner language
statement: Let $C,c\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $V$ be a language of bit strings belonging to $\mathrm{P}$. The language consisting of those bit strings $w$ for which, for every bit string $t$, the pairing of $w$ and $t$ does not belong to the language defined by the bad-specification condition with parameters $C,c,V$ belongs to $\mathrm{coNP}$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a language of bit strings
